## Today's learning {#ss7-objective .lim-lesson }

### Lesson objective

Understand when an infinite geometric series has a finite limiting sum.

### Success criteria

I can explain the condition $|r|<1$, derive $S_\infty=\dfrac{a}{1-r}$ and apply it to numerical and algebraic series.

::: notes

Assume fluency with sequence notation, geometric general terms and finite geometric sums. No input/output recap. The cake supplies a brief reminder of the distinction between a term and a partial sum.

:::
